outcome: Clinicians' experiences of using the QUiPP app
Implementation of the QUiPP app at hospital sites
cohort: Nineteen clinicians (obstetricians and midwives) from 10 hospital sites participated in semi-structured telephone interviews.
finding: The study revealed that clinicians' experiences of using the QUiPP app, how QUiPP risk influenced practice, and the organizational and cultural context at different sites significantly impacted its successful adoption and implementation.
